audit_member_text: ETA_LIMITER is read at L1124 and immediately tested at L1125 without any ierr branch/default; if READ_LOGICAL does not assign on a missing key and the GLOBAL value is not initialized elsewhere, the branch uses an undefined or stale value.

The absorbing DATA phase read jumps from L1275 to label 991 at L1279 on EOF, bypassing CLOSE(1) at L1277; the no-phase fallback therefore leaves unit 1 open while successful phase input sets INPUT_PHASE at L1278.

WAVE_DATA_TYPE is read at L1228 without checking ierr, then sliced at L1255; likewise WidthWaveMaker and R/A sponge-wavemaker reads at L1249-L1252 have no absence handling. Missing keys can therefore propagate undefined/stale configuration into branch selection and sponge calculations unless GLOBAL or INPUT_READ supplies undocumented initialization.

Station buffering loses and/or fabricates samples: once the condition at L2428 is false, the current sample is never inserted before L2435-L2438 flush and reset, so each overflow-triggering sample is dropped. At TIME>=TOTAL_TIME the same ELSE writes exactly StationOutputBuffer rows even when BufferCount is smaller; ZUV_Buffer was allocated at L2374-L2375 but not initialized, so unwritten tail rows can be uninitialized on the first partial flush or stale after later flushes before files close at L2451-L2457.

NumberStations is read at L2048 and used at L2049 without an ierr default; absence handling depends on undocumented prior initialization. The many output logical reads L2065-L2101 likewise overwrite the same ierr and provide no per-flag default in this routine.
